terra.problem: Saying Jeroboam is the last person who would tip off Ahijah assumes a reason or intention the text does not give.
The disguise did not stop her from getting past the door. Ahijah heard her entering it.
The passage does not say the trip was long.
Papa comments on how he is telling the passage by announcing that he is going easy on the jokes.
The quotation uses God’s first-person words, but God is not identified as the speaker before the quote.
Papa comments on how he is telling the passage by announcing that he will keep the jokes out.
The explanation calls the quotation God’s own words, but the passage presents Ahijah speaking about what the LORD found.
The joke about flipping a word on a true-or-false question makes the card’s question the subject of the joke.
The crooked-cookie comparison makes light of the sins and does not make sense: one crooked cookie would not make the whole box come out crooked.
